snippet.description:
The zombies are rising   Z Mission Breakout is Coming to Steam | Gaemster Steam game

From slow walkers to mutated sprinters and armored ex-military corpses, every enemy requires a different tactic to defeat. Watch out for:

Exploder Zombies – Get too close and it’s game over
Crawlers – Silent but deadly
Alpha Units – Boss zombies with super-strength and terrifying speed
